newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares set sights on U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: German shares set sights on U.S. jobs data.

text.p: U.S. unemployment data -- and their impact on global markets -- will provide the next clear direction for the German share market, which closed bourse trade little changed on Thursday.
The 30-share IBIS DAX index was down 1.65 points at 2.454.53 in afternoon trade, just below the floor session close of 2,529.54. September DTB DAX futures were down three points at 2,526.5 points.
"We're still waiting for the U.S. numbers," said a Frankfurt dealer, who said dealings were lacklustre. The U.S. data is due at 1230 GMT on Friday.
Viag unit SKW Trostberg AG rose 1.20 marks, or nearly three percent, to 41.70 marks.
